name: optimization
description: The bounded optimization experiments of #2951, Tools/gauntlet/optimization/optimization.mjs, and its Jet twin, Tools/gauntlet/optimization/optimization/run.jet, #5072 c8: the plan of the five experiment families of a manifest (the repository's, its fixture directories named from the repository root) with each variant's fixture hashes, printed (also with --runs and --timeout-ms, whole and read in part as parseInt reads them) and written to --output; the report of a crafted raw record whose variants are improvements, invalid fast variants that change or keep the output, slow, equal, timed-out and failed runs, blocked, nested and missing inspect records, peers and tiers that are not ready, runtimes that are not numbers and families with no evidence; the usage; and the refusals: an unknown argument, an option without its value, --runs and --timeout-ms that are not positive, report without --raw, the default manifest (its fixture directories are not repository paths), a manifest that is not there, a malformed owner card, and raw records of another schema or manifest. Every harness_sha256 is masked by check.jet.
